card.text: Elongated inner moon of Uranus, named after Othello's wife.

introduction.text: Voyager 2 images revealed Desdemona in January 1986, about 62,659 km from Uranus.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A 90 × 54 × 54 km shape estimate, with two axes assumed equal; there are no surface images.
